products_services: Emergency lighting and fire alarm maintenance
profile.value_proposition: A commercial electrical contractor that landlords and facilities teams in West Yorkshire can leave to it: fixed prices, certificates on the day, out-of-hours work.

pages./: Aire Valley Electrical. Commercial electricians in Leeds. NICEIC approved contractor with 14 engineers. Call for a fixed quote.
pages./services: We look after offices, shops, schools, warehouses and rented property portfolios. Services: electrical installation and fit-out, EICR periodic inspection, emergency lighting and fire alarm testing, EV charge points, planned maintenance contracts. Out-of-hours and half-term work available. We cover Leeds, Bradford, Wakefield and Harrogate and do not travel outside West and North Yorkshire.
pages./clients: Who we work for. Letting agents and block managers, facilities managers, shopfitters and main contractors, and school business managers. Clients include Calder Property Management, Headrow Shopfitting and St Aidan's Academy Trust. We do not do domestic rewires for homeowners.
pages./about: A family firm since 2004. Landlords call us when an EICR is due or a tenancy is changing; contractors call us when a fit-out programme needs an electrical subcontractor at short notice. Jobs range from a £400 inspection to £50,000 fit-outs.

ground_truth: Organisations within roughly 25 miles of Leeds that own, manage or fit out commercial or rented buildings and repeatedly need a commercial electrician: letting agents, block and property management companies, facilities management firms, shopfitters and fit-out contractors, building contractors without in-house electricians, schools and academy trusts, warehouse and office operators, care homes, housing associations. Not electricians or M&E contractors; not electrical wholesalers; not homeowners; not organisations outside Yorkshire.
